title: Content chain now runs the full L3 gate before anything publishes.
summary: Was: content published from any persona at will. Now: a 3-gate chain runs before every publish.
body_md: Every piece of content produced by the content engine now passes a three-stage gate before it goes live. Voice (Freddie). Brand (Anselmo). Legal-liability (Anselmo B6). Only content marked APPROVED at all three gates publishes autonomously. Everything else stops for a human. The chain runs on-loop, unattended, and posts pass through in minutes when they are clean.
why_this_way: Autonomy without gates is a legal problem waiting to happen. Gates without autonomy is a bottleneck. The chain is the smallest structure that does both.
